detail.reason: Observed concurrent gjxl-parallel-tree-fitting workflow queue profiler with generic executable name profile after pilot. The original guard recognized only gjxl_ executable names and missed this job. Exact bytes/decode checks passed, but overlap-free timing is not established. Updated guard recognizes executable paths under GitHub/gjxl.
Diagnostic wrapper falsely classified its own newly spawned Samply target during a process-tree snapshot race. These attempts are retained separately and not used for timing conclusions.
The runner aborted at its post-encode AC-power check. AC power was present when rechecked; no timing from this partial capture is used. A fresh full capture is stored under timed-ac-retry.
